script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Underdogs of Wolverine

INT. WOLVERINE HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

Coach BENNETT (50s, wiry, but still in shape) paces around the empty gym, a basket of basketballs at his feet. He stops, staring at a picture of a victorious team, the Wolverines, in mid-air, their faces frozen in triumph. His eyes glisten with memories.

Coach BENNETT
(whispering)
One day, it'll be these kids' turn.

INT. WOLVERINE HIGH SCHOOL - DAY

In the school's bustling hallway, TEACHER LUCAS (40s, glasses, kind) approaches a group of SCHOLARS (fourteen-year-old students), huddled together in a tight circle, heads down, whispering. He clears his throat.

TEACHER LUCAS
(smiling)
Gentlemen, the bell's about to ring. Off to your classes.

SCHOLAR 1 (nerdy)
(shuffling away)
Yes, sir.

SCHOLAR 2 (athletic)
(rolling his eyes)
Can't wait.

As the scholars disperse, Coach Bennett appears behind Teacher Lucas, surprising him.

Coach BENNETT
Lucas, I need a favor.

TEACHER LUCAS
(pauses)
Sure, Bennett. What's up?

INT. WOLVERINE HIGH SCHOOL GYM - AFTER SCHOOL

In the gym, Coach Bennett gathers FIVE TEENAGERS – MIKE (the jock), JESS (the cheerleader), JIM (the academic), JASON (the troublemaker), and JEN (the new girl). They look at each other uneasily.

Coach BENNETT
Gentlemen, I'm starting a basketball team, and I think it's time we showed the big schools what the small towns can do.

INT. WOLVERINE TOWN SQUARE - NIGHT

The team gathers around the town's old water fountain, practicing passes and lay-ups, talking and laughing. They're a mix of personalities, but they share a common goal – to win.

INT. WOLVERINE HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

Months later, the team faces off against a rival school in the championship game. The tension in the gym is palpable. Coach Bennett looks on nervously, and the crowd is on its feet, cheering.

INT. WOLVERINE HIGH SCHOOL GYM - END

The final buzzer sounds, the gym erupts in cheers. The Wolverines, once the underdogs, stand victorious. Coach Bennett watches with pride as the team lifts the championship trophy, their faces beaming with triumph.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
